prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Charlotte. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Quick question before I make specific recommendations: do you want UV tanning (beds) or a spray tan (airbrush / booth)? Also which part of Charlotte or what ZIP code will you be near? I can then give 4–6 nearby salons with phone numbers and short notes.

If you want suggestions right away, call a mix of one national chain, one boutique spray studio, and one med‑spa or high‑end salon — that will let you compare price, cleanliness, equipment and staff skill. Start with these types/brands (they all have locations in the Charlotte area; I can look up the nearest addresses if you tell me your neighborhood):

- Palm Beach Tan — why call: large national chain with multiple Charlotte locations, predictable hours, membership plans, a range of bed types and sunless options; good to compare prices and equipment age.  
- Tan Republic (or similar mid‑market tanning chain) — why call: more of a spa environment and often higher‑end beds/standups; ask about bed types and training.  
- Planet Beach / automated spray booths (if available nearby) — why call: fast, budget‑friendly spray booths and membership models; good if you want quick, regular spray tans.  
- Local boutique spray‑tan studio or independent airbrush tech — why call: personalized color matching, technician-applied airbrush tans (usually better-looking and longer lasting than automatic booths); ask for photos/portfolio and certification.  
- A local med spa that offers spray tanning or skin prep (medical aesthetician) — why call: best if you have sensitive skin, acne, or want a customized solution with professional skin prep and aftercare advice.

What to ask when you call (so you can compare quickly)
- Do you offer the service I want: UV tanning beds or spray/airbrush tans? Which brands/models of beds or booths do you use?  
- Are technicians certified? Do you do a patch test for spray/tanning solutions?  
- How old are your tanning beds and how often are bed bulbs replaced? (Newer beds and frequent bulb changes = more even, predictable results.)  
- What solutions do you use for spray tans (brand, DHA percentage)? Do you offer custom color?  
- Show me before/after photos or online reviews; can I see client photos?  
- Cleanliness and hygiene: how do you disinfect beds/booths between clients? Do you provide goggles and care instructions?  
- Pricing and memberships: cost per session, packages, cancellation policy, and any introductory specials.  
- For sensitive skin: do you offer fragrance‑free or hypoallergenic solutions?

How to pick once you’ve called
- Choose a tech with good photos and clear answers about products and safety.  
- Prefer a spa that does patch tests for spray tans and that maintains newer beds/regular bulb changes for UV.  
- If you’re fair or have skin concerns, prioritize med spas or certified techs who can customize the solution and prep.

If you tell me your Charlotte neighborhood or ZIP and whether you want UV or spray, I’ll return 4–6 specific salons, with addresses, phone numbers, short notes on what they’re best for, and suggestions for which to call first.
